feed_title: Outdoor Dog Kennel with Access Ramp, Raised Plastic Shell, Weatherproof, Arched Doorway, Wipe Clean, One Size | PawLunova Keswick
descriptionHtml:
A ramp to the doorway. An off-ground floor. No step to manage.

Keswick is a raised outdoor dog kennel with an access ramp up to an arched doorway, in one size, with a wipe-clean plastic shell for supervised garden use.

Watch an older dog at the back step. A front paw goes up, then a pause, then the whole thing happens in one awkward heave rather than in two easy movements. You have started noticing which back leg they push off with.

A ramp changes the shape of that. It turns a lift into a walk, which is the entire reason this kennel exists.

What they get

  • An access ramp to the entrance: A slope rather than a lift. Check the ramp dimensions and whether they suit your dog before ordering.
  • An off-ground resting floor: The raised base separates where they lie from wet grass and mud.
  • A shaped entrance: The arched doorway is part of the kennel's sheltered form.
  • A plastic shell: A damp cloth and mild soap after a muddy afternoon, and there is no fabric in it to launder.

Best for: Supervised garden use where a ramp suits the dog.

Why it is worth the money

£129, and the reason to pick it over anything else on this page is the ramp. Blencathra is the same raised idea at £119 without one. If your dog hesitates at the back step, the extra £10 is buying the thing they hesitate at.

The rest is plastic that wipes down and a floor that sits above the mud. Nothing here needs washing, drying or replacing at the end of a wet season.

The honest part: a ramp only earns its place if the angle and the width suit your dog, and those numbers are not published on this page. Ask us for them before you order. A ramp they will not walk up is just a longer kennel.

Size and fit

Please contact us for the exact dimensions before ordering, including the ramp. Check the internal resting area, entrance height and supported load. Your dog should be able to enter, stand, turn and lie comfortably.

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Wipe the shell with a damp cloth and mild soap. Follow the separate care label for any cushion and store soft furnishings under cover. Allow all parts to dry before use.

Outdoor use: Supervise your dog, provide drinking water and safe shade, and move them indoors in extreme weather. A raised bed, canopy or kennel does not prevent overheating.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

Choose with confidence

This outdoor product has a 30-day change-of-mind window, with return at your cost. It is not covered by the 100-night sleep trial. Your statutory rights are unaffected. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Will my dog use the ramp? Some walk straight up. Others need a few days of being fed at the top first. Send us their breed and weight and we will give you a straight answer on the slope.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Ask us for the ramp measurements and give them a walk up instead of a climb.
